title: Intune Managed App Configuration Policies (iOS & Android) — Zero-Touch App Setup & SSO Routing
author_notes: pricing: T3 — cross-platform app-config feature + vendor SSO-routing example.

Government decision: gov_variant=false. Intune App Configuration Policies are the SAME feature in GCC/GCC High/DoD; only the endpoints differ (portal intune.microsoft.us, Graph graph.microsoft.us via Connect-MgGraph -Environment USGov, device endpoints manage.microsoft.us). No separate Government deliverable required; documented inline in requirements/implementation/troubleshooting. App-specific GCC High parity questions flagged 'verify for GCC High'.

SAP Ariba key-verification: the exact Ariba managed-app-configuration KEY NAMES could not be confirmed — SAP Help is a JS-gated SPA and the ProcurementMobile.pdf is not directly downloadable. Per task directive, general app-config mechanics are authored correctly and Ariba keys are shown as clearly-labeled PLACEHOLDERS flagged 'verify against SAP Ariba documentation', with the authoritative source named: SAP Ariba Procurement Mobile App Guide > 'Configuring SAP Ariba Procurement mobile app in Mobile Device Management Tool' (https://help.sap.com/docs/buying-invoicing/sap-ariba-procurement-mobile-app-guide/configuring-sap-ariba-procurement-mobile-app-in-mobile-device-management-tool ; guide PDF https://help.sap.com/doc/74db2889e01948deac1aaffc667a0c4b/2511/en-US/ProcurementMobile.pdf). Confirmed accurate facts used: SAP states the Ariba Procurement app is NOT MDM-certified on Android (iOS generic MDM only); device passcode required; app blocked on jailbroken/rooted; realm = buyer subdomain from the realm= value of the Ariba SSO/ACS URL. Ariba worked example is therefore iOS-first; Android shown as general pattern with placeholders.

Dedupe boundary: this product OWNS the dedicated App CONFIGURATION Policy topic (pushing app settings + SSO routing). Distinct from mam-app-protection-policies-byod-m365 (App PROTECTION / data controls — different feature), android-enterprise-app-management-managed-google-play-intune (app types/approval/assignment on managed Google Play — references managed config but does not own the App Config Policy topic), and conditional-access-integration (owns the CA build; this product only ROUTES the app to Entra/CA and defers the CA policy authoring to CAI).

Honors AUTHORING_LESSONS: iOS 'Enter XML data' authored as a valid Apple plist (lowercase <dict>, key/string pairs, no xmlns/xsi, no vendor profile header); every 'server/host' value is a hostname, not a URL (no path/slash); apps identified by exact publisher + bundle/package ID; every created object named.
